# `aitbc analytics monitor`

Monitor chain performance in real time or take a single snapshot.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc analytics monitor [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--realtime` | flag | `false` | no | Real-time monitoring |
| `--interval` | integer | `30` | no | Update interval in seconds |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Monitor specific chain |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc analytics monitor
```
